project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind CSS v4 + Recharts 3 dashboard (TypeScript)
build_system: Next.js 16.3.8 via npm. Tailwind v4 uses @tailwindcss/postcss (no tailwind.config.js — all config is via CSS @theme). CSS custom properties defined in src/app/globals.css. No next.config.ts visible so defaults apply.
test_framework: None configured — verification is npm run build (zero TypeScript errors, zero ESLint errors).
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from the ids-dashboard directory. A clean build (exit 0, no TypeScript errors, no ESLint errors) is the pass criterion. Also spin up `npm run dev` and visually confirm each page route loads without console errors.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. The Python backend and all .py files under d:\Intrusion-detection-system\ML Models are completely out of scope — never touch them. Do not run `npm run dev` as a persistent process; only use `npm run build` for verification.
contribution_requirements: 1) Never modify: src/services/apiService.ts (logic), src/lib/mockData.ts (values), src/lib/constants.ts, src/types/index.ts, any Python files. 2) The `id` field on the DataTable Column interface must NOT be removed — it is used as a React key override for the duplicate-key column in analysis/page.tsx (col key='attack_median' appears twice; second column uses id='attack_normal_ratio'). 3) The col.id fix for DataTable already exists — the `key={(col.id ?? col.key) as string}` pattern in DataTable.tsx is correct; preserve it. 4) Never push — all commits local on current branch only.
key_patterns: 1) All colors via CSS custom properties (var(--bg-base), var(--bg-card), var(--border-color), etc.) — no hardcoded hex strings except inside CHART_COLORS and chart components. 2) Tailwind utility classes used for spacing/layout; color tokens via inline style= objects referencing CSS vars. 3) DashboardLayout wraps every page except /home. 4) PageHeader component renders badge + h2 + subtitle. 5) StatCard, ChartCard, DataTable, RiskBadge, PredictionBadge are the shared primitives. 6) CHART_COLORS object in utils.ts supplies hex values to all Recharts components. 7) cn() from clsx used for conditional class merging. 8) Chart tooltip contentStyle hardcodes '#0a1628' and '#1e3a5f' — these must stay in sync with --bg-card and --border-color tokens.
directory_structure: ids-dashboard/src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages (one folder per route). src/components/layout/ — Sidebar, Navbar, DashboardLayout. src/components/ui/ — shared primitive components. src/components/ml/ — ML-specific components. src/components/charts/ — Recharts wrappers. src/lib/ — utilities, constants, mock data, chart helpers. src/services/ — API service. src/types/ — TypeScript type definitions.
